prompt: Write a one-star review of the Liberty Bell from a man who drove eleven hours to see it.
response:
★☆☆☆☆

Drove eleven hours to see the Liberty Bell and honestly, I feel misled. First of all, it’s cracked. Nobody bothered to fix it before putting it on display? Second, you can’t even ring it, which seems like the entire point of a bell. It just sits there behind ropes while everyone whispers like it’s going to do something.

Parking was a nightmare, the line was too long, and after all that, I’m staring at a broken bell for maybe three minutes. I’ve seen bigger bells at churches, and at least those work.

Philadelphia has good cheesesteaks, so that saved the trip from being a total disaster. But the bell itself? One star. Would not drive eleven hours again.
